Random-entry monthly win average · 21 trading days · recent: 5.7/10 · older: 5.6/10. The baseline enters the same stocks on random dates over the same period. Comparison points describe win-rate differences, not investment returns.

Source ordering uses a Wilson-based ranking heuristic on the recent monthly win average, minus the random-entry baseline. It is a ranking heuristic, not a statistical-significance result.

method.firstParagraph: Within each month, calculate the share of fires whose next-close entry finished higher after 21 trading days. Then average those monthly proportions equally. This is not the fraction of winning months or the pooled win rate.
remainingParagraphs: Within each month, calculate the share of fires whose next-close entry finished higher after 21 trading days. Then average those monthly proportions equally. This is not the fraction of winning months or the pooled win rate.

Recent is the test period, with fire dates from 2018-01-01. Older is the training period, before that date. These recipes were searched historically; neither label establishes untouched prospective validation.

Random-entry monthly win average · 21 trading days · recent: 5.7/10 · older: 5.6/10. The baseline enters the same stocks on random dates over the same period. Comparison points describe win-rate differences, not investment returns.

A sighting starts when the full combination changes from false to true. Consecutive days that remain true add no sightings. Yearly frequency averages sightings over the first-to-last span. D and W label daily and weekly bars; indicator lookback is separate.
Source ordering uses a Wilson-based ranking heuristic on the recent monthly win average, minus the random-entry baseline. It is a ranking heuristic, not a statistical-significance result.
